name: Shitara Seiji
source:
A blue-haired young man whose hair is styled suspiciously like Beethoven's, Seiji is part of the chess club and is also your senpai. He thinks very highly of himself, and is a little arrogant. He plays piano and loves music, it is his true passion. Seiji and [url=http://vndb.org/c1268]Konno[/url] are friends, and are the smartest in their grade.

[From [url=http://tokimekimemorialgs.wikia.com/wiki/Category:Tokimeki_Memorial_Girl%27s_Side_3rd_Story]Tokimeki Memorial Girl's Side Wiki[/url]]
